components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill button with an animated gradient ring that sweeps in on hover/focus.
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; display: inline-flex; padding: 1px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(100% 0 0); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(91% 0.015 248 / 0.9); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -1px; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit; background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(86% 0.073 293), oklch(60.5% 0.213 293)); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 400ms; } .ds-btn:hover::after, .ds-btn:focus-visible::after { opacity: 1; } .ds-btn-label { display: inline-flex; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font: 700 0.875rem/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(30.55% 0.052 292.57); border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Round Play Button
components.description: Circular play control that grows and gains the accent gradient on hover.
components.css: .ds-play { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 3.5rem; width: 3.5rem; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(30.55% 0.052 292.57); color: oklch(100% 0 0); cursor: pointer; transition: all 300ms; } .ds-play:hover { height: 4rem; width: 4rem; background: linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(86% 0.073 293), oklch(60.5% 0.213 293)); }

components.name: Full Play Button
components.description: Primary episode CTA: a pill with a circular icon badge and a label.
components.css: .ds-fullplay { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem 0.5rem 0.5rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(100% 0 0); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(91% 0.015 248 / 0.9); font: 700 0.875rem/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(30.55% 0.052 292.57); cursor: pointer; } .ds-fullplay-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 1.75rem; width: 1.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(30.55% 0.052 292.57); color: oklch(100% 0 0); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Bordered field whose only focus signal is a border-color shift (default ring suppressed).
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid oklch(88.09% 0.018 234.53); border-radius: 0.25rem; background: oklch(100% 0 0); color: oklch(45% 0.017 285.89); font: 400 1rem/1.6 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 200ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(59.68% 0.017 285.89); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(57.79% 0.03 234.37); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Text link with an underline that grows left-to-right in the accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-block; padding: 1.25rem 0; font: 400 1rem/1.6 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(30.55% 0.052 292.57); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav::after { content: ''; display: block; height: 1px; width: 0; margin-top: 1.25rem; background: linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(80% 0.105 293), oklch(61% 0.21 293)); transition: width 500ms ease-in-out; } .ds-nav:hover::after { width: 100%; }

components.name: Episode Card
components.description: Flat content surface lifted off the page by tone, not shadow.
components.html:
June 23, 2026

142: The Quiet Stage

A neutral foundation that lets every show take center stage.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1.5rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: oklch(97.65% 0.005 274.97); } .ds-card-art { height: 80px; width: 80px; border-radius: 0.5rem; flex: none; background: oklch(60.5% 0.213 293); } .ds-card-date { font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(59.68% 0.017 285.89); margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-card-title { font: 700 1.125rem/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(30.55% 0.052 292.57); margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-card-desc { font: 400 1rem/1.6 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: oklch(59.68% 0.017 285.89); margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: Starpod is a stage, not a performer. The interface provides the lighting, the structure, and the seating; the podcast itself is the act. Every surface is built so a show's own artwork, voice, and episodes take center stage while the UI holds the wings. Because Starpod is a template adopted by many shows, neutrality is a feature: a near-monochrome low-chroma foundation with a single adaptive accent that shifts from violet by day to cyan by night, in a calm two-part layout of fixed identity rail plus scrollable content and a persistent bottom player.
keyCharacteristics: Content-first: artwork and the play action outrank all chrome.
Adaptive single accent: Iris (violet) in light mode, Aqua (cyan) in dark mode.
Calm, low-chroma neutral surfaces with tonal layering instead of heavy shadow.
Refined-but-playful motion: gradient rings, a tilting cover, a growing play button.
Native and familiar interactions over invented ones.
Dark mode is a first-class, co-equal theme (not an afterthought).

rules.name: The Rationed Accent Rule
rules.body: Iris/Aqua appear on interaction states and active indicators only, never as a section background or large fill. If a screen reads as purple or cyan at rest, the accent has been overused.

rules.name: The Artwork-Is-Loudest Rule
rules.body: On any view, the show's cover art should be the most saturated element; the chrome stays low-chroma so nothing competes with the content.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Inter only. Character belongs to each adopting show via its content and artwork, not via Starpod's font choices.

rules.name: The Lightness-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: To separate two surfaces, move them a step on the tonal ramp before reaching for a shadow. Shadows mean 'this floats,' not 'this is a box.'

dos: Do keep the show's cover art the most saturated element on screen.
Do ration Iris/Aqua to interaction and active states; keep resting surfaces low-chroma.
Do separate surfaces by stepping the tonal ramp before adding a shadow.
Do use Inter across the whole system, varying weight and size for hierarchy.
Do treat dark mode as co-equal: every accent and component has a defined dark-mode counterpart.
Do keep motion refined and purposeful and provide a prefers-reduced-motion alternative for each.
Do lean on native, familiar media affordances (click-to-play, fullscreen, standard controls).
donts: Don't make the UI look like a generic SaaS landing page: no cream/sand backgrounds, no tracked-uppercase eyebrow over every section, no identical icon-heading-text card grids, no hero-metric template.
Don't ship the dated podcast-directory look: tiny artwork, undifferentiated link-soup of platform buttons, or an afterthought player.
Don't hard-code one show's personality, palette, or copy into component structure.
Don't let a screen read as 'purple' or 'cyan' at rest; that means the accent is overused.
Don't add a second typeface for 'character.'
Don't use blur or shadow decoratively; the only sanctioned blur is the functional frosted player bar.
Don't remove focus visibility: inputs suppress the default ring, so keep an AA-contrast focus signal.
Don't use border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe, and never use gradient-filled text.
